name: Gafadurahuette - Drei Schwestern - Kemmi - Silum - Steg
description_md:
The Gafadurahuette to Steg route is a waymarked hiking route in LI. It covers 13.7 km with 962 m of ascent and 1118 m of descent.

This route is signposted as 142 and belongs to the local waymarked hiking network. It is considered easy based on the distance and ascent. The walking time is about 7.2 hours according to the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The path passes within 1800 m of Schloss Vaduz and Vaduz Castle, and within 1900 m of the Landtag.
